description: The figure is a two-level donut (nested pie) chart comparing response outcomes for two conditions labeled “Ambiguity 1 (Outer)” and “Ambiguity 2 (Inner),” each divided into three categories, for a total of 3 slices per ring (6 slices overall). In the outer ring (Ambiguity 1), the slices are labeled Deceived (dark red) at approximately 67.6%, Partially (yellow) at approximately 23.5%, and Not Deceived (dark green) at approximately 8.8%. In the inner ring (Ambiguity 2), the slices are labeled Deceived (bright red) at approximately 57.9%, Partially (yellow) at approximately 31.6%, and Not Deceived (light green) at approximately 10.5%. Percentage values are printed directly on the slices, and two separate legends on the right map colors to labels for the outer and inner rings; no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments appear arranged consistently by category around the circle.
